title: Automotive Data Engineer / Vehicle Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Reisacher Software Team @ GreenTech Hub

Memmingen | Vollzeit | ab sofort | Vergütung nach Erfahrung und Verantwortungsumfang

Arbeitgeber: Reisacher

Recruiting: GreenTech Hub im Auftrag von Reisacher

Aus Fahrzeugdaten belastbare Informationen machen.

Moderne Fahrzeuge liefern große Mengen technischer Daten. Die spannende Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo diese Daten noch keine fertigen Antworten liefern.

Für das Reisacher Software Team suchen wir einen Automotive Data Engineer, der Fahrzeug- und Telematikdaten erschließt, unterschiedliche Datenquellen verbindet und daraus robuste Datenservices und neue digitale Anwendungen entwickelt.

Deine Mission

  • Fahrzeug- und Telematikdaten verschiedener Hersteller über APIs, Streams und weitere technische Schnittstellen erschließen

  • Daten mit Python automatisiert aufbereiten, normalisieren, analysieren und validieren

  • technische Events in Zeitreihen und Datenstreams erkennen

  • unterschiedliche Datenquellen anhand von Zeit, Ort und Fahrzeugzuständen zusammenführen

  • OEM-spezifische Datenmodelle in gemeinsame, nachvollziehbare Datenstrukturen überführen

  • Datenqualität, Aktualität und Plausibilität bewerten

title: Working Student - Robot Learning
description:
Berlin (on-site/hybrid) · Start: January 2027 · 6 - 12 months

About RoboService GmbH

RoboService GmbH works at the frontier of robotics. We bring humanoid robots from the lab to manufacturing and logistics companies, where they work real shifts. We program robotics applications and build a platform that enables companies to teach robots new tasks on their own.

What we offer

You will work with the latest robot learning policies in robotics. Your work focuses on architectures that enable to use robot learning policies across different embodiments, use cases and model compositions.

Your first months at RoboService:

  • You will setup and maintain simulation environments and benchmarks.
  • You will bring different VLA policies, VLM and WAM into one unified runtime.
  • You experiment with different model compositions and architectures.
  • You study how performance differs across different observation and embodiment compositions.
  • You will work with our powerful GPU workstations and in the cloud

What you bring

  • You are enrolled or just finished your Master’s or PhD programme in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science or related field.
  • Hands-on experience with imitation learning or VLA models, shown in a thesis, a paper, a lab project or other work. Examples: openpi, OpenVLA, LeRobot, Octo, diffusion or flow-matching policies
  • Strong in Python and PyThorch, You have trained or fine-tuned a model on a GPU yourself and debugged the run.
  • Experience with at least one robot simulation or benchmark: LIBERO, robosuite, RoboCasa, MuJoCo, ManiSkill or Isaac Sim.

Benefits and Payment

  • Team of experts: You work with engineers who train and deploy VLA models on industrial tasks
  • Berlin based: we are an in-person team in downtown Berlin.
  • Compensation: 17€ / h

title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you are the technical owner of a customer engagement. This is what is globally known as the Forward Deployed Engineer role; at Fireworks in EMEA it carries the AMLE title. You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.
